thread:
Asha (Finance): Heads-up — we have a pool of vendor GPU credits set to expire in 10 days (internal bucket: INT-GPU-2026Q1). Can we move them to teams that will actually consume before expiry? @Jordan @Sam

Jordan (Platform): Do we have a breakdown of who currently has unspent credits vs active usage? I can run a quick query but need the cost centers.

Tess (Billing): billing-bot flagged these yesterday. We can reassign credits but need approvals from cost center owners + infra budget owner. Also watch out for internal audit tag requirements. :warning:

billing-bot: ALERT — Credit pool INT-GPU-2026Q1 expires in 10 days. Remaining balance: 3.4M GPU-minute-equivalents. Eligible projects: infra/*, workloads/datasets/*, research/* (see https://billing.internal/credits/INT-GPU-2026Q1)

Sam (Infra Eng): If we move anything to infra/* that will get consumed by shared queues. But that could mask team usage metrics. Prefer to allocate to teams with planned runs next week.

Kai (DataSci): We have a scheduled sweep for preprod experiments next week that could soak ~800k GPU-min. Would prefer credits to go to datascience-costcenter (cc: ds-team).

Marta (Eng Manager): For approvals, finance requires: 1) cost center owner sign-off, 2) infra owner sign-off, 3) a one-line justification. Can someone DM the approvals?

Asha (Finance): OK — propose allocation: 800k -> datascience-costcenter, 1.5M -> infra-shared-queue, remaining 1.1M -> research/experimental. Need owners to confirm by EOD TOMORROW or credits will expire unused.

Jordan (Platform): I’ll pull tag usage and confirm the infra shared queues that can consume 1.5M. Quick SQL to get recent consumption by tag:```sql
SELECT tag, SUM(gpu_minutes) as used
FROM usage.billing
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY tag
ORDER BY used DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Sam (Infra Eng): Looks good. Two notes: 1) infra-shared will auto-apply credits to queued jobs but cost attribution will show as infra, 2) need billing team to add an audit_tag so we can filter later.

Tess (Billing): I can add audit_tag=INT-GPU-2026Q1 to the transfer. Also confirm approvals: @Marta please approve datascience allocation, @Sam please approve infra allocation.

Marta (Eng Manager): Approved for datascience-costcenter. Justification: "preprod experiment sweep for model benchmarking — planned and scheduled." :white_check_mark:

Sam (Infra Eng): Approved for infra-shared-queue. Justification: "use spare cluster capacity for backlog runs." :white_check_mark:

Asha (Finance): Great — @Tess can you execute the internal transfer and attach approvals thread? Also open a quick ticket so we track consumption vs expiration.

Tess (Billing): Will do. Creating transfer request now and attaching approvals. Transfer ID: TR-2026-04-312. Opening JIRA: FIN-INTCRED-2453 with assignees @Tess and @Jordan. ETA: transfer completes in 2 hours.

billing-bot: TRANSFER COMPLETE — TR-2026-04-312 allocated as: datascience-costcenter:800000, infra-shared-queue:1500000, research/experimental:1100000. Audit tag applied: INT-GPU-2026Q1.

Kai (DataSci): Thanks — will kick off the sweep and report actual consumption numbers to FIN channel tomorrow.

Asha (Finance): Follow-up action: set an alert if pool consumption < 60% in 72 hours so we can decide on redistribution. Jordan, can you add that alert in monitoring?

Jordan (Platform): Yup — adding alert: monitor.billing.credits.INT-GPU-2026Q1.consumption < 60% over 72h -> notify #finance and #platform-ops. Will post link when live.

Marta (Eng Manager): Quick note — for future credit pools can we add a required spend plan at issuance? Makes approvals simpler.

Asha (Finance): Agreed. Adding to monthly billing process doc. Thanks everyone. :pray:
